text: The tight coupling of minority stakes, under which all reputation staked on the losing outcome is slashed in its entirety by burning or redistribution, is the source of the mechanism's incorruptibility.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5887242

isBasedOn.name: The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted

abstract: The key innovation, and the source of the mechanism's incorruptibility, is the "tight coupling" of minority stakes. Here, all reputation staked on the losing outcome is slashed (burned or redistributed) in its entirety.
